versions.short: The bill would change the 2010 Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Act to repeal an earlier water system program and replace it with a new fund account for Crow Tribe water infrastructure projects, covering planning, building, repairing, and operating water and wastewater systems, along with related environmental compliance. It would let the Tribe use leftover funds to buy on-Reservation land with water rights once those projects are finished, keep ownership and control of any infrastructure built with those funds with the Tribe, and state that the federal government has no obligation to pay for operating, maintaining, or replacing those projects. It would also extend a deadline in the Yellowtail Dam provision from 15 years to 20 years and make several technical and conforming changes to cross-references in the 2010 Act.
